matrix.warm_blocks_rule: round(target_seconds * rate / block), clamped to [16, 200000]; --warm-blocks overrides
notes: enabled_pressure is the intentional offline fast-loop starvation/queue-pressure cell; it is separate from the realtime paced enabled cells and never claims worker/clock receipt.
4096 is above the 2048 analysis tap chunk ceiling, so it exercises oversized-callback chunking and remainder handling.
disabled is the control condition: the pipeline is not started but the attached bridge may still be serviced by the processor; the control does not claim a zero-overhead baseline.
Non-device replay: not latency/dropout/device or Windows/ASIO evidence.
Allocation counters are the callback-thread path only; worker allocations are unmeasured.
The 54-cell matrix proves callback coverage; join/stop end-to-end is proven by the supplemental scenarios only.
